meta.parties: Chulalankara Thero v. Lavendris and Others

rules.statement: A plaintiff who is a successor in title to the original plaintiff in an earlier dismissed action, due to appointment as Trustee for a temple, can maintain a new action despite previous dismissals.
rules.supporting_quote: "The present plaintiff-appellant is therefore in no way a privy or successor in title of Ariyajothi Thera, the Viharadhipathi. The title to the temple or to the property did not vest in the plaintiff-appellant as Trustee and the plaintiff-appellant did not derive any title from the Viharadhipathi."
